images.prompt: Polished landscape 16:9 gameplay screenshot of a bureaucratic heaven puzzle game titled "기적 배정과". Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Composition: an elegant celadon-and-cream civil-service interface; left two-thirds is a hand-drawn paper watershed map in soft oblique view with contour lines, a teal river flowing from pale hills, striped farm fields under a small white rain cloud with falling drops, an outdoor semicircular stage with a crowd of dots under a golden sun, a wooden sluice gate across the river glowing with a red warning tag, and a small red-roofed village downstream inside a translucent blue flood zone. Below the map, a formal allocation form with morning and afternoon slots holding rain and sun tokens, selected ones softly highlighted. Right column: three prayer letter cards, the last one sealed with a copper wax seal, a toggle switch for opening the sluice gate, a consequence preview list, and a dark teal send button. Palette: pale celadon, cream, deep teal ink, copper accent, coral warning. Calm, clean, delicate. Korean UI: "기적 배정과", "오전 · 비", "수문 닫힘", button "기적 배정표 발송". Text constraints: the consequence preview reads exactly "들녘 · 비 충족", "마당 · 오후 맑음", "하류 · 수문 닫힘 시 범람 위험" (red); the third letter card is still sealed and shows only "하류에서 온 편지 · 미개봉" with no readable body text.
